description: Sync the STALE local workspace manifest copy under sources/kube/omniroute-memory/ to match the now-LIVE, verified remote state. This runs LAST, after FEAT-001..004 are live and verified, so the committed workspace config reflects reality (NFR3 reproducible config). The local copies currently say 10Gi and carry the old probe/ceiling; update them to the applied values. qdrant is never touched. Commit on the branch; never push.
steps: Diff the local workspace manifests against the live cluster for the fields this task changed, pulling the live values: kubectl -n omniroute-memory get sts ovms-embeddings -o yaml and get deploy ovms-reranker -o yaml and get cm ovms-readiness-scripts -o yaml, and the omniroute env values.

Update sources/kube/omniroute-memory/ovms-embeddings-statefulset.yaml: resources.limits.memory 10Gi->12Gi, model-pull --max_length to the applied value (8192 or the proven fallback), the readiness probe reconciliation if it diverged, and the +50%/12Gi comment rationale.

Update sources/kube/omniroute-memory/ovms-reranker-deployment.yaml: memory 10Gi->12Gi and the +50%/12Gi comment rationale (note in a comment that the live reranker keeps its HTTP probe and the committed /v3/rerank script probe is NOT applied live, per design F8/Out-of-scope).
Update sources/kube/omniroute-memory/ovms-readiness-scripts-configmap.yaml to match the applied embed-probe.sh endpoint reconciliation.
Update sources/kube/omniroute-memory/LIVE-VERIFICATION.md sizing line to the 12Gi/+50% rationale and the applied ceiling value.

Record the OmniRoute env changes (OMNIROUTE_EMBEDDING_SPLIT_MAX_ITEM_TOKENS, OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB=12288) where the workspace tracks them, if anywhere; there is no local sources/kube/omniroute/ dir, so note that the omniroute app change lives only on the remote (kubectl-applied) copy.
Stage ONLY the changed manifest files by name and commit locally on the branch with a clear message. Do NOT push. Do NOT create .changeset files or edit CHANGELOG.md. Do NOT touch qdrant.
acceptance_criteria: Local sources/kube/omniroute-memory/ manifests diff-match the live kubectl get -o yaml for the fields this task changed (memory 12Gi, probe, max_length, comments) (design AC7).
git status shows only the intended manifest files changed; no .changeset or CHANGELOG edits.
verification: Local: diff each updated local manifest's changed fields against ssh ... 'kubectl ... get ... -o yaml' and confirm they agree.
git -C /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/menagerie status --porcelain — only the four omniroute-memory files changed; git log -1 shows the commit on the branch (not pushed).
